newsitem.title: BRAZIL: New Brazil telephone rates take effect today.
newsitem.headline: New Brazil telephone rates take effect today.

text.p: The third and final round of Brazilian telephone rate adjustments went into effect Monday, telephone company officials said.
The 270 percent increase in residential subscription rates and 59 percent rises in non-residential and trunk rates were announced in early April, officials said.

The average monthly residential subscription rate for the federal Telebras system rose to 10 reais from 2.70 reais, while to non-residential rate increased to 15 compared with 9.42 reais. The average trunk rate rose to 20 reais from 12.55.
The increase did not affect cellular rates.
Telebras' largest local operating unit, Telesp, said its residential subscription rate climbed to 13.82 reais from 3.73 reais, while its non-residential rate rose to 20.73 reais from 13.02 reais.
Telesp's trunk rate rose to 27.64 reais from 17.35 reais.
